name: io.github.oscarleoo/chartlink
title: chartlink
description: Charts, maps and tables for AI agents with live-updating embed links. No account: signup returns a key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <chartlink API key>. Get one with POST https://chartlink.app/api/signup (no account needed; the key is shown once).

environmentVariables.name: CHARTLINK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: chartlink API key (viz_...). POST https://chartlink.app/api/signup returns one, no account needed. Optional for listing tools; required for calling them.
